title: Three Years and One Short Bar
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（人与社会·科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（人与社会·科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：iron　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 iron 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the smith ① mended the iron that no builder in the foundry would have recorded, and he said the mending was the whole of the year. The ② iron, meaning the metal itself and not the bar, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; an iron, he said, is the only thing in a foundry that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ iron in that foundry had the same short bar beside it, and the ④ iron at the far anvil, meaning the beam they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An iron, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the smith said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the iron was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the metal. The ⑥ iron, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; iron, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a metal and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ iron had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short bar. The ⑧ iron of the whole thing, the smith wrote in October, was one foundry and three years of recording; iron, he said, is either the beam at the far anvil or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ iron I remember is the metal recorded in the ledger, which closed in 1968 and is still recorded as the quietest in the foundry. An ⑩ iron, my mother said in 1970, is the only metal that improves by being recorded; every iron, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a metal. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 铁；铁制品（指铁厂里每一根旁边的那一根）
B. n. 铁；铁制品（指那根铁料本身，与铁条相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend the iron 修补这根铁条
D. n. 铁；铁制品（指留给孩子们抬的那一根那一根）
E. n. 锻造之事（抽象总称，指一处铁厂的铁之事）
F. n. 铁；铁制品（指账簿里写到、被记下的的那一根）
G. n. 强度、坚韧（指一件事里人人都打却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 坚韧（抽象总称，指人人都打却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mended the iron that no builder in the foundry would have recorded
The iron, meaning the metal itself and not the bar
the iron at the far anvil
the iron was the whole of the matter
the iron had become a line in a ledger
The iron of the whole thing
An iron, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: mend the iron 意为“修补这根铁条”，1961 年那位铁匠把铁厂里没有一位建造工肯记录的一根铁条做了一遍。
iron 意为“铁；铁制品”，指那根铁料本身而不是铁条，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被记录。
iron 意为“铁；铁制品”，指铁厂里每一根旁边的那一根，每一根旁边都有同一根短短的铁条。
iron 意为“铁；铁制品”，指最远那座铁砧留给孩子们抬的那一根那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
iron 意为“强度、坚韧”，指一件事里人人都打却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份强度就是那件事的全部。
iron 意为“坚韧”，指人人都打却无人提起的那样东西而不是那根铁料，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
iron 意为“铁；铁制品”，指账簿里写到、被记下的的那一根，到 1966 年这一根成了账簿里的一行。
iron 意为“锻造之事”，铁匠十月写道，整件事的铁之事是一处铁厂和三个年的记录。
iron 意为“铁；铁制品”，我记得的是账簿里记录过的那一根，1968 年铸成了，至今仍被说成铁厂里最安静的一根。
iron 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，铁是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的铁料。
